JMKE rule: no entry ahead of scheduled supply; the entry is the band OR the Bain secondary when it prices.
edge_note: The prospective edge is FLOW — providing liquidity into sponsor distribution (marketed secondary discount / unlock drift). Valuation-gate WAIT is taxonomy-legal (price at fair, not cheap) and the supply event is a timing finding (tranche/gate, not kill).
